name: CIBOLA Measurement & Verification Agent
description: A neutral AI-governance MEASUREMENT body. Produces and verifies signed measurement cards, SCITT receipts and RFC 3161 time-anchors over the RFC 9943 substrate. A measurement credential is NOT a certification, endorsement or conformity mark. This agent measures; it certifies nothing.

measure.description: Measure a model/system on a GSPC axis registry (16-axis generic or domain: bond/bank/insurance/equity/index/cross-border) using a deterministic gold-label judge (no LLM judges another LLM). Emits a measurement card.

verify.description: Stranger-verify a signed CIBOLA measurement card offline using only the published Ed25519 public key. Detects tampering and pinning to a reference identity.

verifyReceipt.description: Verify an a2a.signed-receipt/0.1 SCITT receipt and confirm it attests to a specific card (content-id binding).

verifyAnchor.description: Verify an RFC 3161 external time-anchor (TSA MessageImprint matches the card digest) plus optional Rekor transparency-log entry.

crosswalk.description: Return the domain->provision crosswalk (jurisdiction-keyed legal/standard citations a score orbits). Cites provisions; never asserts legal compliance.

extends.description: The measurement-card payload this agent produces/verifies.

skills.name: measure
skills.description: Run a deterministic GSPC measurement and emit a signed card.

skills.name: verify
skills.description: Stranger-verify a signed card with the public key only.

skills.name: verify-receipt
skills.description: Verify an SCITT receipt and bind it to a card.

register: This is a measurement credential. It is not a certification, endorsement, or conformity mark, and must not be presented as one.
